purpose: Select one economically interpretable Campaign026 mechanism without opening a Campaign026 minute partition, market-benchmark value, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_concept.economic_question: Does a stock co-move more consistently with broad-market rises than with broad-market declines during the same session, indicating upside participation with relative downside resilience that may persist from the next open through the third close?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: A stock whose synchronous market dependence is stronger during positive broad-market minutes than during negative broad-market minutes may participate in common upside information while resisting common selling pressure. That asymmetric resilience may carry over the next three sessions.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Use all 238 within-half one-minute close returns at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, partitioned only by the sign of the synchronous equal-weight leave-one-out market return; exclude standalone 09:30, lunch, overnight, cross-day, and cross-stock transitions.
known_design_risks: correlation versus beta, market-sign partitioning, exact-zero market returns, minimum observations per sign, estimator, direction, and subwindows are researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
the concept may be statistically associated with market-idiosyncratic share or own-return skewness even though neither measures conditional synchronous dependence
stronger upside dependence than downside dependence may indicate resilience or merely transient positive convexity, so direction must be frozen before returns
using market-return magnitudes, thresholds, quantiles, leads, lags, late-session subsets, regressions, activity weights, or terminal factor values would change the mechanism

rejected_concepts.reason: Overall market dependence and idiosyncratic share are already terminal mechanisms; Campaign026 must condition on market direction instead of reopening their unconditional definitions.
Campaign021 already measured one-minute stock-versus-market response-delay asymmetry. Campaign026 must remain synchronous and use no lead or lag.
Own-return distribution asymmetry is terminal and does not require a leave-one-out market state. Campaign026 must condition dependence on the external market sign.
Combining, aggregating, transforming, or rescuing Campaign001-Campaign025 terminal definitions is prohibited.
